# TrainMate

> India's first verified travel companion platform for train passengers.

TrainMate is a free Android app that helps Indian Railways passengers find verified co-travelers on the same train. Users can chat securely in-app, split cab fares at stations, coordinate seat swaps, track PNR status, and make lasting friendships — all without sharing personal contact details. Built for the 8+ billion annual Indian Railways passengers.

## Core Features
- Verified passenger matching via PNR confirmation
- Secure encrypted in-app chat (no phone number sharing)
- Cab fare splitting coordination at stations
- Real-time PNR status tracking with platform & coach updates
- Gamified trust system with profile badges and reputation points
- Works on all Indian Railways trains: Rajdhani, Shatabdi, Duronto, Express, and more

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is TrainMate?
TrainMate is a free Android app that helps Indian Railways passengers find verified co-travelers on the same train. Users can chat securely, split cab fares, coordinate seat swaps, and make friends — all without sharing personal contact details.

### How does passenger verification work?
TrainMate verifies users through PNR confirmation, ensuring they have a valid ticket on the same train. Profile verification badges indicate confirmed travelers, giving you confidence that your matches are real co-passengers.

### Is TrainMate free?
Yes, all core features — including co-traveler matchmaking, PNR status tracking, and group chat — are 100% free. TrainMate aims to build a clean railway community across India.

### Is my personal information safe?
TrainMate never shares your mobile number, exact seat number, or personal credentials with others. All communication happens in-app via encrypted chat. Your privacy is always protected.

### Which trains does TrainMate support?
TrainMate covers all Indian Railways trains including Rajdhani, Shatabdi, Duronto, Express, and local trains. Simply add your PNR or train number and the app matches you with fellow passengers.
